plan.scope: Require phase resolution only for nonzero cosine/sine hazard coefficients; preserve numerical tolerance, 62-evaluation cap and uncertainty policy. No timing default adoption or I11 action effects.
plan.added_real_audio_control: Existing sustain/stair produced no ordinary arrival forecasts. Add a frozen 0.171-second amplitude pulse train to exercise short-period integration on actual audio.

contract.gate: Require width <= period / 4 only when the context has a peak and at least one of cosine/sine hazard coefficients 10/11 is nonzero. Exact zero comparison; no near-zero tolerance.
contract.preserved: Original feature mapping, two-point Gauss-Legendre refinement, absolute/relative error tolerance, 62-evaluation cap, uncertain-reset bounds, candidate receipt rules and causal ownership remain unchanged.
contract.constant: A phase-independent constant hazard converges after six evaluations even with a short period. Period/support/missing-indicator coefficients may remain nonzero since their within-window features are constant.
contract.observed_and_candidate: Both use the same integral. Observed arrival probabilities and their downstream diagnostic head inputs may change; this is a numerical support correction, not an observation-invariance claim.
contract.limits: Nonzero phase coefficients retain the existing resolution guard, including very small coefficients. No larger integration budget, phase approximation or unknown-to-silence substitution.
